topics.description: Recent charges and sentencing in Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases have brought attention to the issue of healthcare fraud in the state. Multiple cases have been reported, including a $4M scheme and a $46M scheme.
The Feeding Our Future scandal has been trending due to the sentencing of the founder, Alethea Stansberry, to 41.5 years in prison. The scandal involved a $250M scheme to defraud the government.
